slots.palette: soft cool pastel palette with warm wood accents
slots.setting: a cozy little ramen shop in a narrow alley on a rainy afternoon, for cute hungry animals
slots.decorations: Pale wooden shop fronts, short cloth noren, a few colourful umbrellas, potted plants and soft rain streaks only around the edges of the screen.
slots.background_tones: soft (cream, light wood, pale rainy grey)
slots.kitchen: a steaming ramen kitchen hatch with a short noren curtain and a small umbrella stand beside it
slots.loop_interior: a calm shallow rain puddle on pale stone with a few gentle ripples
slots.foods: a mini ramen bowl, a gyoza, an onigiri, a soft-boiled egg half or a small skewer
slots.counter: a light wooden ramen counter under a small cloth awning
slots.board_surface: a pale wooden counter top framed with a thin darker wood border
slots.obstacles: a small folded umbrella, a soy sauce bottle and a small teacup
slots.mood: snug, calm and cozy, sheltered from the rain, with everyone happily eating
slots.lighting: Soft overcast light with warm glow from the shop
slots.extra_avoid: rain or raindrops over the belts, the counter or the board, wet reflections on the tickets, dark grey backgrounds behind the tickets, readable shop signs
